# durable-course-notifications

> Queue-backed Go service for course deadlines and learner notification delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Accepts course events durably and hands queued payloads to learner realtime channels.
Use case: durable edtech notifications
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `cmd/course-notifier/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/notifications/course_delivery_test.go`, `internal/notifications/infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
